matpr = function(A){
  pra = "\\begin{bmatrix}\n"
  for(i in 1:dim(A)[1]){
    pra = paste0(pra,paste0(A[i,],collapse=" & "))
    if(i<dim(A)[1]){pra = paste0(pra,"\\\\\n")} else {pra = paste0(pra,"\n")}
  }
  pra = paste0(pra,"\\end{bmatrix}")
  return(pra)
}

matpr_missing = function(A,ii,jj){
  pra = "\\begin{bmatrix}\n"
  for(i in 1:dim(A)[1]){
    for(j in 1:dim(A)[2]){
      if(i==ii && j==jj){
        pra = paste0(pra,"?")
      } else {
        pra = paste0(pra,A[i,j])
      }
      if(j<dim(A)[2]){
        pra = paste0(pra, " & ")
      }
    }
    if(i<dim(A)[1]){
        pra = paste0(pra, "\\\\\n")
    } else {
        pra = paste0(pra, "\n")
      }
  }
  pra = paste0(pra,"\\end{bmatrix}")
  return(pra)
}

while(T){
  ij = sample(1:3,2)
  i = ij[1]

  a = matrix(sample(1:6,9,T)*sample(c(-1,1),9,T),nrow = 3)
  b = matrix(sample(1:6,9,T)*sample(c(-1,1),9,T),nrow = 3)
  pra = matpr(a)
  prb = matpr(b)
  p = matrix(a%*%b,nrow=3)
  prp = matpr(p)
  ans = p[i,j]
  PPP = matpr_missing(p,i,j)
  if(max(abs(p))<100 && abs(ans)>0){break}
}

$$`r pra` \cdot `r prb` = `r PPP`$$
